                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Discount = 10%

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Marked Price = 10% above Cost Price

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Concept Used:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Selling Price = [(100 - Discount%)/100] × MP

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Loss = CP - SP

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Loss % = [Loss/CP] × 100

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Let the CP be Rs. 100.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Marked Price = 10% above Cost Price

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Marked Price = Rs. 110

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Discount = 10%

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Selling Price = [(100 - Discount%)/100] × MP

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Selling Price = [(100 - 10%)/100] × 110

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ [90/100] × 110

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ Rs. 99

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Loss = CP - SP

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 100 - 99 = Rs. 1

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Loss % = [Loss/CP] × 100

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ [1/100] × 100

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 1%

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            His loss percentage is 1%.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.

                                                                                                                            ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            छूट = 10%

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            अंकित मूल्य = क्रय मूल्य से 10% अधिक

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            विक्रय मूल्य = [(100 - छूट%)/100] x अंकित मूल्य

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            हानि = क्रय मूल्य - विक्रय मूल्य

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            हानि % = [हानि/क्रय मूल्य] x 100

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            मान लीजिए क्रय मूल्य 100 रुपये है।

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            अंकित मूल्य = क्रय मूल्य से 10% अधिक

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            अंकित मूल्य = 110 रुपये 

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            छूट = 10%

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            विक्रय मूल्य = [(100 - छूट%)/100] x अंकित मूल्य

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            विक्रय मूल्य = [(100 - 10%)/100] x 110

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ [90/100] x 110

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 99 रुपये 

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            हानि = क्रय मूल्य - विक्रय मूल्य

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 100 - 99 = 1 रुपये

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            हानि % = [हानि/क्रय मूल्य] x 100

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ [1/100] x 100

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 1%

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            उसका अभीष्ट हानि प्रतिशत 1% है।

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ∴ विकल्प 1 सही उत्तर है।

                                                                                                                            \n\nd9:T629,

                                                                                                                            ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            తగ్గింపు = 10%

                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A can complete a work in 12 days.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B can complete a work in 8 days.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Concept Used:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Time = Total Work/Efficiency

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A can complete a work in 12 days.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A's 1 day work = 1/12

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B can complete a work in 8 days.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B's 1 day work = 1/8

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            (A + B)'s 1 day work = 1/12 + 1/8

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 5/24

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            (A + B)'s 1 day work is 5/24.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Number of days required to complete the work if both A and B work together is 24/5 or 4.8 days.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.

                                                                                                                            \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A, 12 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकता है।

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B, 8 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकता है।

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            समय = कुल कार्य/दक्षता

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A, 12 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकता है।

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A का 1 दिन का काम = 1/12

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B, 8 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकता है।

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B का 1 दिन का काम = 1/8

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            (A + B) का 1 दिन का काम = 1/12 + 1/8

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 5/24

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            (A + B) का 1 दिन का काम 5/24 है।

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            यदि A और B दोनों मिलकर काम करते हैं तो काम पूरा करने में लगने वाले दिनों की संख्या 24/5 या 4.8 दिन है।

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ∴ विकल्प 3 सही उत्तर है।

                                                                                                                            ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A ఒక పనిని 12 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలడు.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B ఒక పనిని 8 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలడు.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            సమయం = మొత్తం పని/దక్షత

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            గణన:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A ఒక పనిని 12 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలడు.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A యొక్క 1 రోజు పని = 1/12

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B ఒక పనిని 8 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలడు.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B యొక్క 1 రోజు పని = 1/8

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            (A + B) ల 1 రోజు పని = 1/12 + 1/8

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 5/24

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            (A + B) ల 1 రోజు పని 5/24.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A మరియు B లు కలిసి పనిచేస్తే ఆ పనిని పూర్తి చేయడానికి అవసరమైన రోజుల సంఖ్య 24/5 లేదా 4.8 రోజులు.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ∴ ఎంపిక 3  సరైన సమాధానం.

                                                                                                                            \n", "mr": "

                                                                                                                            दिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A एक काम 12 दिवसात पूर्ण करू शकतो.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B एक काम 8 दिवसात पूर्ण करू शकतो.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            वापरलेली संकल्पना:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            वेळ = एकूण काम/कार्यक्षमता

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A एक काम 12 दिवसात पूर्ण करू शकतो.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A चे 1 दिवसाचे काम = 1/12

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B एक काम 8 दिवसात पूर्ण करू शकतो.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            B चे 1 दिवसाचे काम = 1/8

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            (A + B) चे 1 दिवसाचे काम = 1/12 + 1/8

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 5/24

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            (A + B) चे 1 दिवसाचे काम 5/24 आहे.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            जर A आणि B दोन्ही एकत्र काम करत असतील तर काम पूर्ण करण्यासाठी लागणारे दिवस 24/5 किंवा 4.8 दिवस आहेत.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ∴ पर्याय 3 हे योग्य उत्तर आहे.

                                                                                                                            \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                            প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            A একটা কাজ 12 দিনে করতে পারে।

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            (A + B)-এর 1 দিনের কাজ হল 5/24

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            25% of a number is 1320.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Let the number be x.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            25% of a number is 1320

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ [25 × x]/100 = 1320

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ x/4 = 1320

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ x = 5280 

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Number is 5280.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Now, 35% of 5280

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ [35/100] × 5280

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ⇒ 1848

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            ∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.

                                                                                                                            The correct answer is Kannada and Telugu.

                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Key Points

                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                            • Kannada is a Dravidian language spoken predominantly by people of Karnataka in the southwestern region of India.
                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                            • Telugu is another Dravidian language spoken in the Indian states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                            • Both Kannada and Telugu were given the status of Classical languages in 2008 by the Government of India.
                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                            • Classical language status is granted to languages which have a rich heritage and independent nature, and meet certain criteria set by the Ministry of Culture in India.
                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                            • Classical Language Status\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • The Government of India awards the Classical Language status to languages that have a rich historical and cultural heritage.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • To be considered for Classical Language status, a language must have a recorded history of over 1500-2000 years, have a body of ancient literature/texts, and possess an original literary tradition that is not borrowed from another speech community.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • Languages that have been conferred this status receive financial assistance for setting up study centers dedicated to the language and for the development of its literature.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                            • Dravidian Languages\n\t
                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • Dravidian languages form a family of languages spoken mainly in southern India and parts of eastern and central India.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • There are around 80 languages in this family, with the major ones being Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • These languages have a distinct script and rich literary traditions dating back several centuries.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                            • Kannada\n\t
                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • Kannada is spoken by approximately 44 million people.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • The earliest examples of Kannada literature date back to the 9th century.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • The language has a rich literary tradition with significant contributions in poetry, drama, and prose.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                            • Telugu\n\t
                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • Telugu is spoken by over 75 million people.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • It is one of the classical languages of India, with a rich literary history that dates back to the 2nd century BCE.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                              • Telugu literature has a vast array of works ranging from classical poetry to modern novels and plays.
                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                              • \n
