                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  दिलेल्या माहितीनुसार:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  तो नंतर उजवीकडे वळतो, 10 किमी गाडी चालवतो, उजवीकडे वळतो आणि 5 किमी गाडी चालवतो.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  तो शेवटचा उजवा वळण घेतो, 3 किमी गाडी चालवतो आणि बिंदू X वर थांबतो.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  अंतिम मांडणी:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  সুতরাং, বিন্দু X থেকে বিন্দু B পশ্চিম দিকে 7 কিমি দূরে অবস্থিত।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ನೀಡಲಾಗಿರುವ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ: ಐದು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಒಂದು ನೇರ ಸಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ, ಉತ್ತರ ದಿಕ್ಕನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  K ಮತ್ತು N ಎರಡು ತುದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  R, L ರ ತಕ್ಷಣದ ಎಡಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದಾನೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಅಂತಿಮ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  R என்பவர் L இன் இடதுபுறம் அருகில் அமர்ந்திருக்கிறார்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Compound Interest Formula:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \\(A = P(1 + \\frac{R}{100})^T\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  চক্রবৃদ্ধি সুদের সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \\(A = P(1 + \\frac{R}{100})^T\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  যেখানে, A = প্রদেয় মোট পরিমান 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  P = মূলধন 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  R = সুদের হার

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  T = সময়

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  প্রথমে, আমাদের মূলধন (P) বের করতে হবে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  সুদ (I) = A - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  যেহেতু I = 612 টাকা, আমরা পাই:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  612 = \\(P(1 + \\frac{4}{100})^2 - P\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ 612 = \\(P[(1 + \\frac{4}{100})^2 - 1]\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ 612 = આપેલ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  મુદ્દલ (P) = ₹ y

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  વ્યાજનો દર (R) = 4% વાર્ષિક

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  સમયગાળો (T) = 2 વર્ષ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  વ્યાજ (I) = ₹ 612

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ચક્રવૃદ્ધિ વ્યાજનું સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \\(A = P(1 + \\frac{R}{100})^T\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  જ્યાં, A = ચૂકવવાપાત્ર કુલ રકમ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  P = મુદ્દલ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  R = વ્યાજનો દર

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  T = સમયગાળો

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  સૌ પ્રથમ, આપણે મુદ્દલ (P) શોધવાની જરૂર છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  વ્યાજ (I) = A - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  કારણ કે I = ₹ 612, આપણી પાસે છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  612 = \\(P(1 + \\frac{4}{100})^2 - P\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ 612 = \\(P[(1 + \\frac{4}{100})^2 - 1]\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ 612 = \\(P[(1 + 0.04)^2 - 1]\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ 612 = P[1.0816 - 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ 612 = P[0.0816]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ P = 612/0.0816

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ⇒ P = 7500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  હવે, બે વર્ષ પછી ચૂકવવાપાત્ર કુલ રકમ (A)ની ગણતરી કરો:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A = \\(P(1 + \\frac{R}{100})^T\\)A = \\(7500(1 + \\frac{4}{100})^2 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A = 7500(1.04)2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A = 7500 x 1.0816

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A = 8112

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  બે વર્ષ પછી ચૂકવવાપાત્ર કુલ રકમ ₹ 8,112 છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n16c:T77e,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಅಸಲು (P) = ₹ y

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಬಡ್ಡಿದರ (R) = ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ 4%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಸಮಯ (T) = 2 ವರ್ಷಗಳು

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಬಡ್ಡಿ (I) = ₹ 612

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಚಕ್ರಬಡ್ಡಿ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \\(A = P(1 + \\frac{R}{100})^T\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಇಲ್ಲಿ, A = ಪಾವತಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಒಟ\n್ಟು ಮೊತ್ತ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  P = ಅಸಲು

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  R = ಬಡ್ಡಿದರ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  T = ಸಮಯ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಮೊದಲು, ನಾವು ಅಸಲು (P) ಅನ್ನು ಕಂಡುಹಿಡಿಯಬೇಕು.ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಅಸಲು (P) = ₹ y

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಬಡ್ಡಿದರ (R) = ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ 4%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಬಡ್ಡಿ (I) = ₹ 612

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಚಕ್ರಬಡ್ಡಿ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \\(A = P(1 + \\frac{R}{100})^T\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಇಲ್ಲಿ, A = ಪಾವತಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಒಟ\n್ಟು ಮೊತ್ತ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  I = ₹ 612 ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ನಾವು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದೇವೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A = 7500(1.04)2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A = 7500 x 1.0816

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  A = 8112

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  ಎರಡು ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಅವಧಿಯ ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾವತಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೊತ್ತ ₹ 8,112.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The correct answer is magnetic field increases.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • A solenoid is a coil of wire that generates a magnetic field when an electric current passes through it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The magnetic field inside a solenoid is directly proportional to the number of turns per unit length of the coil.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Increasing the number of turns increases the number of magnetic field lines per unit length, thereby increasing the strength of the magnetic field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • This effect is due to the principle of superposition of magnetic fields created by each individual loop of the solenoid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Solenoid:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A solenoid is a type of electromagnet formed by a helical coil of wire through which an electric current flows.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • It generates a uniform magnetic field in a volume of space when a current passes through it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Solenoids are used in a variety of applications including electromagnets, inductors, transformers, and valves.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Magnetic Field:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • A magnetic field is a vector field that describes the magnetic influence on moving electric charges, electric currents, and magnetic materials.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Magnetic fields are generated by electric currents, which can be macroscopic currents in wires or microscopic currents associated with electrons in atomic orbits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Electromagnetism:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Electromagnetism is a branch of physics that deals with the study of electromagnetic forces, a type of physical interaction that occurs between electrically charged particles.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • This force is described by electromagnetic fields, which include electric fields and magnetic fields.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
