                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • இந்த விசை மின்புலங்கள் மற்றும் காந்தப்புலங்களை உள்ளடக்கிய மின்காந்தப்புலங்களால் விவரிக்கப்படுகிறது.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n178:T1402,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଏ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଏକ ସୋଲେନଏଡ୍ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ତାରର କୁଣ୍ଡଳୀ ଯାହା ଏକ ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ସ୍ରୋତ ଏହା ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଇ ଗତି କଲେ ଏକ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଏକ ସୋଲେନଏଡ୍ ଭିତରର ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର କୁଣ୍ଡଳୀର ପ୍ରତି ୟୁନିଟ୍ ଲମ୍ବର ଘେର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ସହିତ ସିଧାସଳଖ ସମାନୁପାତିକ ଅଟେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଘେର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରତି ୟୁନିଟ୍ ଲମ୍ବର ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ରେଖାର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଥାଏ, ଫଳରେ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରର ଶକ୍ତି ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଥାଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଏହି ପ୍ରଭାବ ସୋଲେନଏଡର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ଲୁପ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୋଇଥିବା ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସୁପରପୋଜିସନ୍ ନୀତି ହେତୁ ହୋଇଥାଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସୂଚନା

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ସୋଲେନଏଡ୍:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଏକ ସୋଲେନଏଡ୍ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ପ୍ରକାରର ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟ୍ ଯାହା ତାରର ଏକ ହେଲିକାଲ୍ କୁଣ୍ଡଳୀ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଗଠିତ ଯାହା ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଇ ଏକ ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ସ୍ରୋତ ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହୁଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଯେତେବେଳେ ଏହା ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଇ ଏକ ସ୍ରୋତ ପ୍ରବାହିତ ହୁଏ, ସେତେବେଳେ ଏହା ଏକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଏକ ସମାନ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ସୋଲେନଏଡ୍ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରୟୋଗରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୁଏ, ଯେପରିକି ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟ୍, ଇଣ୍ଡକ୍ଟର, ଟ୍ରାନ୍ସଫର୍ମର ଏବଂ ଭାଲ୍ଭ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଏକ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ହେଉଛି ଏକ ଭେକ୍ଟର କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ଯାହା ଚଳମାନ ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ଚାର୍ଜ, ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ସ୍ରୋତ ଏବଂ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ ପଦାର୍ଥ ଉପରେ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ ପ୍ରଭାବକୁ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ସ୍ରୋତ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୁଏ, ଯାହା ତାରରେ ମାକ୍ରୋସ୍କୋପିକ୍ ସ୍ରୋତ କିମ୍ବା ପରମାଣୁ କକ୍ଷପଥରେ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରନ୍ ସହିତ ଜଡିତ ମାଇକ୍ରୋସ୍କୋପିକ୍ ସ୍ରୋତ ହୋଇପାରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟିଜିମ୍:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟିଜିମ୍ ହେଉଛି ପଦାର୍ଥ ବିଜ୍ଞାନର ଏକ ଶାଖା ଯାହା ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ଶକ୍ତି, ଏକ ପ୍ରକାରର ଭୌତିକ ପାରସ୍ପରିକ କ୍ରିୟା ଯାହା ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ଚାର୍ଜ ଥିବା କଣିକା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଘଟିଥାଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଏହି ଶକ୍ତି ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟିକ୍ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ଦ୍ୱାରା ବର୍ଣ୍ଣିତ, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ଏବଂ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n179:T125e,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ ਹੈ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਵਧਦਾ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଏ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଏକ ସୋଲେନଏଡ୍ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ତାରର କୁଣ୍ଡଳୀ ଯାହା ଏକ ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ସ୍ରୋତ ଏହା ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଇ ଗତି କଲେ ଏକ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଏକ ସୋଲେନଏଡ୍ ଭିତରର ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର କୁଣ୍ଡଳୀର ପ୍ରତି ୟୁନିଟ୍ ଲମ୍ବର ଘେର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ସହିତ ସିଧାସଳଖ ସମାନୁପାତିକ ଅଟେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଘେର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରତି ୟୁନିଟ୍ ଲମ୍ବର ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ରେଖାର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଥାଏ, ଫଳରେ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରର ଶକ୍ତି ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଥାଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଏହି ପ୍ରଭାବ ସୋଲେନଏଡର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ଲୁପ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୋଇଥିବା ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସୁପରପୋଜିସନ୍ ନୀତି ହେତୁ ହୋଇଥାଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସୂଚନା

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ସୋଲେନଏଡ୍:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଏକ ସୋଲେନଏଡ୍ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ପ୍ରକାରର ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟ୍ ଯାହା ତାରର ଏକ ହେଲିକାଲ୍", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ ਹੈ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਵਧਦਾ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਮੁੱਖ ਨੁਕਤੇ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਇੱਕ ਸੋਲਨੋਇਡ ਤਾਰ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਕੁਆਇਲ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦਾ ਕਰੰਟ ਲੰਘਣ 'ਤੇ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਇੱਕ ਸੋਲਨੋਇਡ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਕੁਆਇਲ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਯੂਨਿਟ ਲੰਬਾਈ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੋੜਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੇ ਸਿੱਧੇ ਅਨੁਪਾਤੀ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਮੋੜਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਵਧਾਉਣ ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਯੂਨਿਟ ਲੰਬਾਈ ਵਿੱਚ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਰੇਖਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਵਧ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਦੀ ਤਾਕਤ ਵਧ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਸੋਲਨੋਇਡ ਦੇ ਹਰੇਕ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਲੂਪ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਬਣਾਏ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੁਪਰਪੋਜੀਸ਼ਨ ਦੇ ਸਿਧਾਂਤ ਦੇ ਕਾਰਨ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ਵਾਧੂ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਸੋਲਨੋਇਡ:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇੱਕ ਸੋਲਨੋਇਡ ਇੱਕ ਕਿਸਮ ਦਾ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰੋਮੈਗਨੇਟ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਤਾਰ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਹੈਲਿਕਲ ਕੁਆਇਲ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦਾ ਕਰੰਟ ਵਗਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਹ ਜਦੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਕਰੰਟ ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਲੰਘਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਲੀ ਥਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਸਮਾਨ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਸੋਲਨੋਇਡ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰੋਮੈਗਨੇਟ, ਇੰਡਕਟਰ, ਟ੍ਰਾਂਸਫਾਰਮਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਲਵ ਸਮੇਤ ਕਈ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਐਪਲੀਕੇਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇੱਕ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਇੱਕ ਵੈਕਟਰ ਖੇਤਰ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਚੱਲ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦੇ ਚਾਰਜਾਂ, ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦੇ ਕਰੰਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਸਮੱਗਰੀਆਂ 'ਤੇ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਦਾ ਵਰਣਨ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦੇ ਕਰੰਟਾਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਪੈਦਾ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਜੋ ਤਾਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੈਕਰੋਸਕੋਪਿਕ ਕਰੰਟ ਜਾਂ ਪਰਮਾਣੂ ਔਰਬਿਟਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰੌਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਮਾਈਕ੍ਰੋਸਕੋਪਿਕ ਕਰੰਟ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰੋਮੈਗਨੇਟਿਜ਼ਮ:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰੋਮੈਗਨੇਟਿਜ਼ਮ ਭੌਤਿਕ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਸ਼ਾਖਾ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰੋਮੈਗਨੈਟਿਕ ਬਲਾਂ, ਇੱਕ ਕਿਸਮ ਦੀ ਭੌਤਿਕ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਜੋ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦੇ ਚਾਰਜ ਕੀਤੇ ਕਣਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਦੇ ਅਧਿਐਨ ਨਾਲ ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ਇਸ ਬਲ ਦਾ ਵਰਣਨ ਇਲੈਕਟ੍ਰੋਮੈਗਨੈਟਿਕ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਿਜਲੀ ਦੇ ਖੇਤਰ ਅਤੇ ਚੁੰਬਕੀ ਖੇਤਰ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n17a:Tea3,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Pencil appears bent.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • When a pencil is immersed in water, it appears bent due to the phenomenon of refraction of light.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Refraction occurs because light travels at different speeds in different mediums, such as air and water.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The pencil looks bent at the point where it enters the water because light rays bend as they pass from water to air, creating an optical illusion.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • This bending of light rays makes the submerged part of the pencil appear at a different position compared to the part that is above water.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Refraction\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Refraction is the change in direction of a wave passing from one medium to another caused by its change in speed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • When light travels from a less dense medium (like air) to a denser medium (like water), it slows down and bends towards the normal line (an imaginary line perpendicular to the surface).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Conversely, when light travels from a denser medium to a less dense medium, it speeds up and bends away from the normal line.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The amount by which the light bends depends on the refractive indices of the two media.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The correct answer is Pencil appears bent.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • When a pencil is immersed in water, it appears bent due to the phenomenon of refraction of light.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Refraction occurs because light travels at different speeds in different mediums, such as air and water.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The pencil looks bent at the point where it enters the water because light rays bend as they pass from water to air, creating an optical illusion.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • This bending of light rays makes the submerged part of the pencil appear at a different position compared to the part that is above water.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Refraction\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Refraction is the change in direction of a wave passing from one medium to another caused by its change in speed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • When light travels from a less dense medium (like air) to a denser medium (like water), it slows down and bends towards the normal line (an imaginary line perpendicular to the surface).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Conversely, when light travels from a denser medium to a less dense medium, it speeds up and bends away from the normal line.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The amount by which the light bends depends on the refractive indices of the two media.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Optical Illusion\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • An optical illusion occurs when the information gathered by the eye is processed by the brain to give a perception that does not match the physical reality.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The bending of the pencil in water is a classic example of an optical illusion caused by refraction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Refractive Index\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The refractive index of a medium is a measure of how much the speed of light is reduced inside the medium.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • It is defined as the ratio of the speed of light in a vacuum to the speed of light in the medium.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • For example, the refractive index of water is approximately 1.33, meaning light travels 1.33 times slower in water than in a vacuum.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Snell's Law\n\t
